_comment: The launch week: the daily's first seven days, hand-picked to hook new players. Day 1 is launch day (LAUNCH in js/engine.js); each day plays its seven prompts in this order. Picks favour prompts everyone can answer with deep keys (so a rare find is always possible), one or two light ones a day, and a mix of packs. Every id must be a core prompt (not extra or off-topic). Before launch the daily never deals these; after the week the usual shuffle starts with the core prompts not used here.
